main_mystery: Who built the post-Kessler reform into a national capture instrument -- who are the co-owners behind Renn, and who architected using the correction itself to entrench the fraud at national scale?
truth: Stellan Marsh architected the National Integrity Directorate as a capture instrument: the reform built to prevent the next Kessler is the mechanism by which he and the co-owners who financed Renn now control national procurement, laundering the same fraud at the scale of a country behind the credibility of the body meant to stop it.

red_herrings.description: A lone method-copycat (Petra Lund) faked the coupons using Renn's old method on her own initiative.
The money did it; Gerald Halveston's fund captured the contracts and is the mastermind.

clues.description: Iris recovers a physical fractured coupon from the Meridian Spine project site, showing an anomalous signature.
Discovery of falsified load coupons signed by Petra Lund for the Meridian Spine, using an override method similar to Kessler's.
Iris identifies a specific, recurring micro-signature (tool-mark) on Lund's falsified coupons, identical to the Kessler override method.
Investigation reveals the specific machining/press tooling used to create the fraud's tool-mark was never in Petra Lund's inventory or control.
A critical piece of investigative data, known only to Iris and Nadia, is leaked or acted upon by the network before Iris officially files it.
Iris reconstructs that Nadia's 'helpful' leads were true-but-incomplete — each one steered the inquiry toward Halveston's fund and away from Directorate sponsorship chains.
Forensic accounting shows Gerald Halveston's philanthropic fund strategically moved money to capture key Meridian Spine contracts.
Analysis of Directorate approvals reveals a pattern where 'clean' certifications consistently align with Halveston's fund's investment positions.
Iris identifies a suspicious pattern in the timing of the Directorate's 'clean verdicts,' strategically released to restore public trust.
Iris confirms the identical physical tool-mark signature appears on other projects certified by the Directorate, including the Kessler fraud, not just the Meridian Spine.
Evidence confirming Stellan Marsh's foundational role in creating and chairing the National Integrity Directorate, positioned as the reform's architect.
Stellan Marsh, under public and investigative pressure, makes a statement on live record regarding his role and the Directorate's function.

The assembled physical evidence (recurring tool-marks, Directorate approval patterns, timing of verdicts) conclusively proves common authorship of the national capture, linking Spine fraud to Kessler, Halveston's fund, and Marsh's Directorate.

major_reveals.description: Petra Lund is revealed as the executor of the Meridian Spine fraud, having signed off on falsified load coupons with a specific tool-mark.
False Answer 1 ('a lone method-copycat') is debunked, as the specific tooling for the fraud was never in Lund's possession, indicating a source above her.
Nadia Okafor is revealed as a betrayer, having guided Iris's investigation by leaking leads prematurely, curating which top Iris would reach.
Iris releases a partial tool-mark match between the Meridian Spine fraud and the Kessler collapse, reopening the Spine's certification but naming no one.
Gerald Halveston is revealed as the coordinator, having moved money through his philanthropic fund to capture Meridian Spine contracts.
False Answer 2 ('Halveston, the money, did it') is debunked, as evidence shows his fund was guided by the Directorate, implying a higher architect.
The National Integrity Directorate itself is revealed to be a national capture instrument, assembled from three pieces of evidence.
Stellan Marsh's connection as the founder and beneficiary of the Directorate is established, linking him to the instrument of capture.
Stellan Marsh is revealed as the architect of the national capture, having built the National Integrity Directorate as the mechanism for laundering fraud at a national scale.
The complete, irrevocable tool-mark proof linking the Spine fraud to Kessler, the fund, and Marsh's architecture is published, after Marsh states his role on live record.
